SEPTIC ARTHRITIS (NATIVE JOINT) WITH GRAM NEGATIVE BACILLI (OTHER THAN

PSEUDOMONAS)

Administer parenteral therapy initially for approximately 1-2 weeks

then can be converted to appropriate oral therapy.

Duration of treatment for 4 weeks depending on response

# Oral therapy to complete the course after intravenous therapy initially:

[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID \($\) R](psozid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-14ds-po-bid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-14ds-po-bid)

[Levofloxacin 500mg PO qday \($\) R,DI](psozid2-levofloxacin-14ds-500mg-po-qday)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-levofloxacin-14ds-500mg-po-qday)
